sentences.en: Today, President Trump's chief of staff holds a surprise press conference to say things are stable in the White House.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统的幕僚长举行了一场突发新闻发布会，称白宫局势稳定。

sentences.en: And survivors of one of the most persecuted ethnic groups on Earth, the Rohingya, are telling their stories.

sentences.en: We'll jump right in.

sentences.en: Glenn Thrush, what happened Thursday inside the White House press briefing room?
sentences.zh: 格伦·思拉什，周四白宫新闻发布厅里发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Sarah Huckabee Sanders, the president's press secretary, came out as usual.

sentences.en: And behind her was this tall man.

sentences.en: So with that, I'm going to turn it over to the chief of staff.

sentences.en: Good afternoon.

sentences.en: Great to be here.

sentences.en: A couple of comments, I guess, and then opened it up for Q&A.
sentences.zh: 我想先说几句，然后再开始问答环节。

sentences.en: And Glenn, what does General Kelly say once he gets to the podium?
sentences.zh: 格伦，凯利将军走到讲台后说了什么？

sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: I'm not quitting today.

sentences.en: I don't believe, and I just talked to the president, I don't think I'm being fired today.
sentences.zh: 我不认为，而且我刚和总统谈过，我不觉得我今天会被解雇。

sentences.en: The narrative was getting away from John Kelly.
sentences.zh: 舆论导向正在脱离约翰·凯利的掌控。

sentences.en: The first spade of stories were very, very positive.

sentences.en: He had taken control of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他已经掌控了白宫。

sentences.en: He had gotten rid of some of the wooliest characters that he believed were sort of contaminating the process there.
sentences.zh: 他清理掉了一些他认为正在污染白宫运作流程的“害群之马”。

sentences.en: But there's been a whole spade of stories about how Kelly had kind of overshot his role in terms of cracking down and taking control of the place.
sentences.zh: 但随后出现了一大批报道，称凯利在整顿和接管白宫方面有些越权了。

sentences.en: So on one hand, the narrative has served him really, really well as a guy who's stabilized things.

sentences.en: But he realized the moment had come where he needed to get out there and defend himself personally.
sentences.zh: 但他意识到，现在是他必须亲自站出来为自己辩护的时候了。

sentences.en: So if Kelly was defending himself, who was he defending himself from?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果凯利是在为自己辩护，他是在防备谁？

sentences.en: What was he defending himself against?

sentences.en: Great question.

sentences.en: As usual, it's two audiences.

sentences.en: Actually, it's three audiences.

sentences.en: It's us, obviously, the press, which he focused on.
sentences.zh: 首先显然是我们，媒体，这是他关注的重点。

sentences.en: The second audience is the staff of the White House.

sentences.en: And, of course, the audience of one that Sean Spicer would perform for every single day.

sentences.en: Meaning?
sentences.zh: 什么意思？

sentences.en: Donald John Trump.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·约翰·特朗普。

sentences.en: You know, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I read in the paper, you all know, you write it, that, you know, I've been a failure at controlling the president or a failure at controlling his tweeting and all that.
sentences.zh: 我在报纸上读到，你们都知道，你们写的，说我在控制总统方面失败了，或者在控制他的推文等方面失败了。

sentences.en: Again, I was not sent in or I was not brought to this job to control anything but the flow of information to our president so that he can make the best decisions.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我被派到这个岗位上，或者说我被带到这份工作中，不是为了控制任何事情，而是为了控制呈报给总统的信息流，以便他能做出最好的决策。

sentences.en: Why would he feel the need to say that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么会觉得有必要说这些？

sentences.en: As best I can tell, he wasn't asked a question about whether he controls the president.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，当时并没有人问他是否控制了总统。

sentences.en: Because the president of the United States will fire anybody who tries to control him or make their lives so miserable that they want to quit.
sentences.zh: 因为美国总统会解雇任何试图控制他的人，或者让他们的日子过得极其痛苦，直到他们想辞职。

sentences.en: Period.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: And that's the paradox of Trump.

sentences.en: He needs to be managed.

sentences.en: He's the least experienced president in terms of government experience that we've had recently.
sentences.zh: 他是我们近期历史上政府经验最匮乏的总统。

sentences.en: And yet he is somebody who really, really bristles at being controlled.
sentences.zh: 然而，他却是一个非常、非常反感被控制的人。

sentences.en: President Trump in recent days has gotten into a bit of a war of words with Senator Bob Corker, the latest Republican who he's had a public feud with.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统最近几天与参议员鲍勃·科克发生了一些口角，这是他最近公开争执的共和党人。

sentences.en: Within the past couple of days, Glenn,
sentences.zh: 格伦，在过去几天里，

sentences.en: Senator Bob Corker, a very senior lawmaker who deals in foreign relations, said a couple of very provocative things about the president.
sentences.zh: 参议员鲍勃·科克，一位处理外交事务的资深议员，对总统说了一些非常有挑衅意味的话。

sentences.en: One was that he thought the White House was adult daycare for the president that monitored him and made sure that he didn't do something irresponsible.
sentences.zh: 一是他说白宫就像是总统的“成人日托中心”，有人盯着他，确保他不做出不负责任的行为。

sentences.en: And he said that there were three senior members of the White House staff who he believed stood between this president and essentially chaos.
sentences.zh: 他还说，有三位白宫高级官员，他认为他们站在总统和混乱之间。

sentences.en: The other was
sentences.zh: 另外两位是

sentences.en: Defense Secretary

sentences.en: James Mattis and Secretary of State
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·马蒂斯和国务卿

sentences.en: Rex Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森。

sentences.en: How did those comments, which got a lot of attention, fit into what Kelly came out and talked about on Thursday?
sentences.zh: 这些引起广泛关注的评论，与凯利周四出来谈论的内容有何关联？

sentences.en: If you listen to Kelly carefully, nothing that he said when he came out in the briefing room contradicted the notion put forth by Corker that he,
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细听凯利的话，他在发布会上所说的一切，并没有反驳科克提出的观点，即他、

sentences.en: Secretary of Defense
sentences.zh: 国防部长

sentences.en: James Mattis and Secretary of State
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·马蒂斯和国务卿

sentences.en: Rex Tillerson were stabilizing the administration.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森正在稳定政府。

sentences.en: Just listen carefully to the way that he describes it.
sentences.zh: 只要仔细听他描述的方式就知道了。

sentences.en: He said, no, no, no, I am not trying to control the president.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，不，不，我不是在试图控制总统。

sentences.en: I restrict no one, by the way, from going in to see him.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我没有限制任何人去见他。

sentences.en: But when we go in to see him now, rather than onesies and twosies, we go in and help him collectively understand
sentences.zh: 但现在我们去见他时，不再是一个一个地去，而是集体去帮助他理解

sentences.en: what
sentences.zh: 他

sentences.en: what he needs to understand to make these vital decisions.

sentences.en: So, again, I was not sent into or brought in to control him and you should not measure my effectiveness as a chief of staff by what you think I should be doing, but simply
sentences.zh: 所以，再说一次，我被派到这里或带到这里不是为了控制他，你们不应该用你们认为我应该做的事情来衡量我作为幕僚长的效力，而应该简单地看

sentences.en: the fact is I can guarantee to you that he is now presented with options, well thought out options.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我可以向你们保证，他现在面对的是各种选择，经过深思熟虑的选择。

sentences.en: Those options are discussed in detail with his team and then he comes up with the right decision.
sentences.zh: 这些选择会与他的团队详细讨论，然后他会做出正确的决定。

sentences.en: Well, that is controlling the president.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那这就是在控制总统。

sentences.en: Controlling paper and people is the job of a gatekeeper, traditional role of a chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 控制文件和人员是守门人的工作，这是幕僚长的传统角色。

sentences.en: He is seizing on sort of a semantic device and he knows his boss very well.
sentences.zh: 他是在利用某种语义手段，而且他非常了解他的老板。

sentences.en: He knows his boss does not like the language of control.
sentences.zh: 他知道他的老板不喜欢“控制”这个词。

sentences.en: Very clever by Kelly and very much in keeping with his success in climbing the chain of command in the military.
sentences.zh: 凯利这一招非常聪明，也非常符合他在军队中晋升的成功经验。

sentences.en: It's almost as if you're saying that while Kelly goes out there and reassures the president
sentences.zh: 这听起来就像是，凯利一方面出去安抚总统说

sentences.en: I'm not trying to do anything you don't want me to do.

sentences.en: He is simultaneously reassuring the rest of the world don't worry I got this.

sentences.en: Boom.

sentences.zh: 今天你看到了他在白宫西翼走钢丝的样子。

sentences.en: That's what made this press conference so fascinating.

sentences.en: It was all out in public.

sentences.en: This is really, really hard work running the United States of America.

sentences.en: I don't run it

sentences.en: Glenn that General Kelly came out on Thursday and said what he said about not being fired and that he doesn't control the president because he's afraid that if he doesn't

sentences.en: Rajuma is a young woman who grew up in a small rice farming hamlet in Myanmar.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛（Rajuma）是一位年轻女性，她在缅甸的一个小稻农村庄长大。

sentences.en: She's a Rohingya Muslim.
sentences.zh: 她是罗兴亚穆斯林。

sentences.en: Rajuma thought she was around 20 years old, but she looked about 14.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛以为自己大约20岁，但她看起来只有14岁左右。

sentences.en: She was very thin, had these delicate wrists that looked like they could easily break.
sentences.zh: 她非常瘦弱，手腕纤细，仿佛一折就会断。

sentences.en: She had a jagged scar on her chin, another scar on her head, and she clearly had been traumatized.
sentences.zh: 她的下巴上有一道锯齿状的伤疤，头上还有另一道伤疤，显然她曾遭受过创伤。

sentences.en: And I sat with her for several hours in this hut, essentially,
sentences.zh: 我基本上和她在那个小屋里坐了几个小时，

sentences.en: sitting on the ground, and as she told us more about where she lived, she gave me a sense of a very divided, isolated world that she had grown up in.
sentences.zh: 坐在地上。当她向我们讲述更多关于她居住地的情况时，她让我感受到她所成长的世界是一个非常分裂、与世隔绝的世界。

sentences.en: And Jeffrey, what's the story that Rajuma told you?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，拉朱玛告诉了你什么故事？

sentences.en: So Rajuma told me one of the worst stories
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛告诉了我我这辈子听过的

sentences.en: I've ever heard in my life.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的故事之一。

sentences.en: And for anybody listening,
sentences.zh: 对于任何正在收听的人来说，

sentences.en: what she lived through was very upsetting, very disturbing, and she described it in quite graphic detail.
sentences.zh: 她所经历的一切非常令人不安、非常令人震惊，而且她描述得非常生动具体。

sentences.en: So this is what Rajuma told me.
sentences.zh: 这就是拉朱玛告诉我的。

sentences.en: On the morning of August 30th, she woke up to see dozens of government soldiers jogging into her village.
sentences.zh: 8月30日清晨，她醒来时看到几十名政府军士兵正小跑着进入她的村庄。

sentences.en: And Rajuma was with her family, cowering in her house, watching a village burn down around her.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛当时和家人蜷缩在屋里，看着村庄在周围燃烧。

sentences.en: Rajuma had a small child, about 18 months old, named Muhammad Sadiq.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛有一个大约18个月大的小孩子，名叫穆罕默德·萨迪克（Muhammad Sadiq）。

sentences.en: It was her first child, and she said that she ran out of her house with her family members, clutching this little boy in her arms, and she was quickly captured by soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这是她的第一个孩子。她说她抱着这个小男孩和家人一起跑出屋子，很快就被士兵抓住了。

sentences.en: And then she, along with several other people I talked to who had described the exact same sequence of events, said that the families were marched to a riverbank,
sentences.zh: 然后，她和另外几位我采访过的人（他们描述了完全相同的事件经过）说，这些家庭被押送到河岸边，

sentences.en: and the men were separated from women, and the men were quickly executed by the soldiers, who either shot them in the head, or used these long knives and slit their throats.
sentences.zh: 男人和女人被分开，男人被士兵迅速处决，他们要么朝他们的头部开枪，要么用长刀割断他们的喉咙。

sentences.en: Oh, jeez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: The women and children were standing there made to watch this, and then they were told to go stand in a river and wait.
sentences.zh: 妇女和儿童站在那里被迫观看这一幕，然后他们被命令去河里站着等待。

sentences.en: And at this point when I was talking to her, she got really quiet, and I felt bad for asking for more information, but I felt it was important to document.
sentences.zh: 当我跟她谈到这一点时，她变得非常安静。我为索要更多信息感到难过，但我认为记录下来很重要。

sentences.en: So Rajuma said that these soldiers were looking at her, and they called her out of the water while she was holding her son.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛说，这些士兵盯着她看，在她抱着儿子的时候把她从水里叫了出来。

sentences.en: And they pointed their guns at her, and they said, you.
sentences.zh: 他们用枪指着她，说：“你。”

sentences.en: She didn't even want to move.
sentences.zh: 她甚至不想动。

sentences.en: And they yelled it louder, you.
sentences.zh: 他们更大声地喊道：“你。”

sentences.en: And while she was walking out of the water and being led to a house, these men grabbed her baby out of her arms, and she said that she fought as hard as she could,
sentences.zh: 当她走出水面被带往一间屋子时，这些人从她怀里抢走了她的孩子。她说她拼命反抗，

sentences.en: but she was probably five feet tall and less than a hundred pounds and was quickly overpowered.
sentences.zh: 但她可能只有五英尺高，体重不到一百磅，很快就被制服了。

sentences.en: And she said she watched these soldiers throw her baby son into a fire, and he burned to death.
sentences.zh: 她说她看着这些士兵把她的幼子扔进火里，他被活活烧死了。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And there were other women who told me the same thing had happened to them.
sentences.zh: 还有其他妇女告诉我，她们也遭遇了同样的事情。

sentences.en: And this is when she was hit in the face with a club,
sentences.zh: 就在这时，她的脸被棍子击中，

sentences.en: nearly knocked out, screaming, crying, and then dragged into a house and gang raped.
sentences.zh: 几乎昏死过去，尖叫着、哭泣着，然后被拖进屋子轮奸。

sentences.en: And her mother and her sister and her younger brother were in the same house, and her sisters were also raped, and all the family except for her was killed.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲、姐姐和弟弟也在同一间屋子里，她的姐妹们也遭到了强奸，除了她以外，全家人都被杀了。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, what you're describing is surreally cruel.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，你所描述的简直是超乎寻常的残忍。

sentences.en: It was, and it's very rare, even when you're a journalist who covers a lot of these conflicts, to meet somebody who has lived through something like that.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。即使对于报道过许多此类冲突的记者来说，遇到经历过这种事情的人也是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: How did Rajuma make it out after what the soldiers did?
sentences.zh: 在士兵们做出这些事之后，拉朱玛是如何逃出来的？

sentences.en: Rajuma told me that she woke up after being raped.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛告诉我，她在被强奸后醒了过来。

sentences.en: She had passed out.
sentences.zh: 她当时昏过去了。

sentences.en: She doesn't know how long.
sentences.zh: 她不知道昏迷了多久。

sentences.en: And she woke up in a house filled with smoke.
sentences.zh: 她在一间烟雾弥漫的屋子里醒来。

sentences.en: And she ran out naked, covered in blood, by herself.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体、浑身是血地独自跑了出去，

sentences.en: and she hid in a field and spent the night in this forest near the village, watching soldiers continue to kill people.
sentences.zh: 躲在田野里，在村庄附近的森林里过了一夜，看着士兵们继续杀人。

sentences.en: And then in the morning began to run.
sentences.zh: 然后在清晨开始奔跑。

sentences.en: And she found some scraps of clothes along the way, and she kept running.
sentences.zh: 她在路上找到了一些碎布片，然后继续奔跑。

sentences.en: And eventually, she got far enough away from the village where she met other people who were coming out of hiding, who had been survivors of other massacres.
sentences.zh: 最终，她跑到了离村庄足够远的地方，遇到了其他从藏身处出来的人，他们是其他大屠杀的幸存者。

sentences.en: And together in a small group, they began to walk towards the border of Bangladesh.
sentences.zh: 他们组成了一个小团体，开始向孟加拉国边境走去。

sentences.en: And as they walked, the group got bigger and more survivors trudged out of the bushes in the forest to join them.
sentences.zh: 随着他们的行走，队伍越来越大，更多的幸存者从森林的灌木丛中蹒跚而出加入他们。

sentences.en: And they finally got to the border and she crossed on a small boat and began to join the hundreds of thousands of people who were doing the exact same thing and seeking refuge
sentences.zh: 他们终于到达了边境，她坐上一艘小船渡过河，开始加入成千上万做着同样事情并寻求避难的人群，

sentences.en: in these large, sprawling, messy, muddy camps that have sprung up nearly overnight on the border between Bangladesh and Myanmar on the Bangladeshi side.
sentences.zh: 在孟加拉国和缅甸边境的孟加拉国一侧，几乎一夜之间涌现出这些巨大、杂乱、泥泞的营地。

sentences.en: Let me make sure I understand who Rajuma says carried this out.
sentences.zh: 让我确认一下我是否理解拉朱玛所说的执行者是谁。

sentences.en: Who was it?
sentences.zh: 是谁干的？

sentences.en: So Rajuma and dozens of people I talked to were very clear about who carried this out.
sentences.zh: 拉朱玛和我采访过的几十个人都非常清楚是谁干的。

sentences.en: It was the government of Myanmar's military and some police units.
sentences.zh: 是缅甸政府军和一些警察部队。

sentences.en: They were wearing uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着制服。

sentences.en: They were carrying rifles.
sentences.zh: 他们带着步枪。

sentences.en: These were not wild mobs.
sentences.zh: 这些不是暴民。

sentences.en: This was organized.
sentences.zh: 这是有组织的。

sentences.en: She said she saw people talking on telephones and helicopters in the air when this operation was happening.
sentences.zh: 她说她看到人们在打电话，行动发生时空中还有直升机。

sentences.en: There was no effort to disguise it or keep it secret.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有试图掩盖或保密。

sentences.en: These soldiers had come into her village with the intent to wipe everybody out.
sentences.zh: 这些士兵进入她的村庄就是为了把所有人赶尽杀绝。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, why would the Myanmar military do what you're describing to women and children?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，为什么缅甸军队会对妇女和儿童做出你所描述的这种事？

sentences.en: In your telling and in the telling of the witnesses that you've talked to it doesn't just sound like murder.
sentences.zh: 在你的讲述和你采访过的目击者的讲述中，这听起来不仅仅是谋杀。

sentences.en: It sounds like
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是

sentences.en: deliberate
sentences.zh: 蓄意的

sentences.en: extraordinary cruelty.
sentences.zh: 非同寻常的残忍。

sentences.en: It's actually hard to fathom why one group of people would ever do this to another.
sentences.zh: 事实上，很难理解为什么一个群体会对另一个群体做出这种事。

sentences.en: So help us understand how this could be happening.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我们理解这怎么可能发生。

sentences.en: You know, it's really sad but I think the government military had a mission to wipe out the Rohingya community and they didn't care if they were men, women, or little babies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的很可悲，但我认为政府军的任务是消灭罗兴亚社区，他们不在乎对方是男人、女人还是小婴儿。

sentences.en: They wanted to wipe out every single Rohingya.
sentences.zh: 他们想消灭每一个罗兴亚人。

sentences.en: They wanted to erase their existence.
sentences.zh: 他们想抹去他们的存在。

sentences.en: And the reason why,
sentences.zh: 至于原因，

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like madness but I think there's more to it than that because not everybody goes insane at the same time like that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来像是疯狂，但我认为事情没那么简单，因为不是每个人都会同时变得那么疯狂。

sentences.en: This is part of a long story that begins years ago with this Rohingya community a Muslim-speaking ethnically Bengali community that got tucked into Myanmar during the partition
sentences.zh: 这是一个漫长故事的一部分，始于多年前。罗兴亚社区是一个讲穆斯林语言、种族上属于孟加拉的社区，在二战后印度和英国殖民地分治期间被划入缅甸。

sentences.en: of India and the British colonies after World War II.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，主要是佛教徒且种族差异巨大的缅甸政府就一直妖魔化罗兴亚人，声称他们窃取了最好的土地，

sentences.en: And ever since then the Myanmar government which is mostly Buddhist and ethnically very different has demonized the Rohingya and said that they have stolen the best land
sentences.zh: 称他们是害虫、毒蛇和昆虫，说他们不属于缅甸。这种情况越来越严重，罗兴亚人的权利被剥夺，

sentences.en: and that they're vermin and snakes and insects and that they don't belong inside Myanmar and this just got worse and worse and rights were taken away from the Rohingya
sentences.zh: 他们被拒绝给予公民身份，结婚困难，上学困难，离开村庄也困难。与此相关，一个罗兴亚武装组织出现了，

sentences.en: they were denied citizenship it was difficult to get married difficult to go to school difficult to leave the village and then connected to this a Rohingya militant group sprung up
sentences.zh: 他们开始攻击政府阵地，试图保卫罗兴亚人民。这造成了一种暴力循环，给了政府

sentences.en: and they started attacking government positions and trying to defend the Rohingya people and their words and this created this cycle of violence that gave the government
sentences.zh: 试图消灭整个罗兴亚社区的完美借口，因为现在罗兴亚人被贴上了恐怖分子的标签。他们很快就声称罗兴亚

sentences.en: to the ground and then sealed off and all the witnesses scattered in a million different directions and it's been very hard to try to piece together what exactly happened
